description: Standorte der öffentlichen Feuerwehren BB is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by inspire.brandenburg.de. Der Datensatz beinhaltet Daten vom LSTE über die Standorte der öffentlichen Feuerwehren und Werkfeuerwehren Brandenburg und wird über je einen Darstellungs- und Downloaddienst bereitgestellt. Die Standorte wurden zunächst aus dem ALKIS-Gebäudedatenbestand des Landes Brandenburg abgeleitet. Coverage: DE. Its keywords include Brandschutz, Brand, Feuerwehr. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS. The listing shows 2026-03-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
